pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Whiteglove Movers is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A calm, orderly moving van interior with blanket-wrapped pieces neatly secured

children: Whiteglove Movers began with a simple conviction: a move should feel handled, not endured. We take on a limited number of moves at a time, so every family and every executive gets a dedicated manager and the full attention the day deserves.

From a cross-country relocation to a single fragile heirloom, we bring the same care — an honest estimate, a meticulous crew, and a calm hand on every detail from the first survey to the last piece placed.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: You’re never handed off. The manager who surveys your home is the one who runs the move — the plan, the crew and the timeline all in one pair of hands.
We survey thoroughly and quote precisely, then hold to it. No day-of surprises, no creeping numbers — just the figure we agreed on.
Every move is fully insured and every item handled as if it were irreplaceable — because to the family it belongs to, it usually is.
